description: The card for a search by searchId: finished picks with receipts, or its running status. Free and instant. Use it to finish a search_stays call that returned 'running', or to read a shared stay (https://stayotter.com/stay/s_…). Each pick's stay card page on the site also draws the block (venues by kind, groceries, nearest stop) and lists map facts for walking back at night; the method is at https://stayotter.com/street-reading. For a group deciding together, https://stayotter.com/vote/<searchId> is a no-account vote page on the picks.

searchId.description: The searchId from search_stays, or the id in a stayotter.com/stay/s_… link
